name: Ignition System Response and Diagnostic Metrics
description: The Ignition Gateway UI displays system response and diagnostic information, including current response time, severity, recent slow response events, tuning scripts, and garbage collector counts.

name: Layer Count reflects single-density rack configuration
description: The Layer Count field is described in the training as reflecting the rack property configuration, and this site uses a single layer.

name: stunnel active connection display
description: The stunnel display reports active connections and shows traffic statistics for individual service connections.

name: VISU_IO_DIAG Control Temps Section
description: The 'Control Temps' section on the VISU_IO_DIAG screen displays the temperature readings of the CPU and the motherboard (MB) inside the HMI.

name: HMI CYCLE STOP Control
description: The CYCLE STOP button on the operator station HMI is used to stop the tipping cycle during a fault recovery process.

name: Robot count summary metrics on the map monitor
description: The summary area presents counts for actively running robots and robots currently charging.

name: Lane Activity and Dimension Data
description: The displayed MDI Support chat references Lane Activity as recording Scandata, Induct, and SortConf, and describes missing dimension data affecting tote handling.

name: Package dimension data fields
description: The package data view includes Length, Width, Height, Weight, and Cube fields used to represent package dimensions and related measurements.

name: Types of customer-defined calculations
description: There are three types of customer-defined calculations: system statistics, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

name: Robot count metrics shown in the message panel
description: The message panel includes count-based metrics for active robots and robots charging.

name: VISU_MANCONTROL Informational Banner
description: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen contains an informational banner (Item 1) that displays alarms or informational messages. Arrows on the right side of the banner allow navigation through messages.

name: Ignition memory trend
description: The Ignition Gateway performance page includes a memory trend that can show a memory spike followed by a drop to zero after a crash.

name: E-stop statistics as a statistics type
description: E-stop is one of the statistics types available within the Overall System Statistics view.

name: Location Active Dwell Model
description: The Robotics Database includes a LocationActiveDwellModel table that displays active AGV dwell records at locations marked for DwellTracking.

name: Tote exchange weight-related parameters
description: The Tote Exchange Settings screen includes weight-related parameters labeled Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold.

name: AGV fault statistics
description: GetAgvFaultStats retrieves the current AGV fault statistics.

name: Visu_MCP_Dual JOG Button
description: The JOG button on the Visu_MCP_Dual screen allows manual control of the end effector and gripper position. Only maintenance personnel should use this function.

name: Disconnected AGV count and RMS communication concept
description: The disconnected AGV count shows how many AGVs the RMS considers disconnected due to lost communication or other causes such as being turned off.

name: Ignition Gateway Performance Metrics
description: The Ignition Gateway UI displays performance-related monitoring areas and trends for CPU, memory, system response, and related services.

name: Visu_MCP_Dual Axis Position Indicators (A1, Z1, A2, Z2)
description: The Visu_MCP_Dual screen displays current axis positions in steps for the left gripper (A1, Z1) and right gripper (A2, Z2). A green 'R' circle indicates the axis has been referenced; a yellow data field indicates axis motion.
